customer_message: الصورة عند مدخل العمارة اللي جنبنا، والطلب ما وصلني. شفت إشعار بالمبلغ بس مدري نزل فعلاً أو بس تحت الإجراء. إذا ما نزل رجعوا لي المبلغ.

events.detail: Driver took the vacuum out on the residential route.
Driver uploaded a photo of the exterior entrance.

proof_of_delivery.detail: Carrier review identifies the photographed entrance as a neighboring building.

customer_message: The original box just showed up as back at your warehouse. I got a dispatch email last week but couldn't tell if it was for this return. If you haven't sent another one, please resend it to the same address.

events.detail: The parcel was directed to an unstaffed receiving bay and handoff failed.
Carrier collected the original unit for return.
Retailer matched the returned original to the order.

customer_message: أمس العصر مكتوب إن المندوب سلّم الخلاط، بس محد عندنا استلمه. جاني تنبيه إن الاسترجاع بدأ، ولا شفت المبلغ. إذا ما اكتمل أبي فلوسي ترجع.

events.detail: The parcel went out on the neighborhood route.
The driver recorded a handoff at the lobby desk.

proof_of_delivery.detail: The signature mark cannot establish who took the blender.

customer_message: There's an old refund entry on this order and I'm not sure what it was for. The bin has gone back and I'd still like one. I've moved since I ordered, so don't use the address on file.

events.detail: The building desk advised that the recipient had moved.
Carrier collected the parcel for return transport.
Retail warehouse intake matched the parcel to the order.

customer_message: آخر شي عندي إنها بمستودع شركة الشحن. ما عاد أبي الجهاز، رجعوا لي المبلغ على نفس البطاقة. إذا العنوان القديم للحين مسجل لا ترسلون عليه شي.

events.detail: The intended receiving desk was closed.
The carrier scanned the parcel into its returns staging area.
The retailer's receiving team scanned and accepted the parcel at its warehouse.

customer_message: The driver called this afternoon to say they'd checked the delivery photo again. That's my porch, but I still don't have the box. It first showed delivered yesterday morning.

events.detail: Driver left the local depot with the scale.
The driver recorded the porch drop-off and uploaded a photo.

proof_of_delivery.detail: Carrier review matched the shipping label and the porch in the photo to this order.

customer_message: حالة الطلب عندي تقول مرتجع والمنتج خلص من الموقع. أبي المبلغ يرجع للبطاقة، ما أقدر أنتظر لين يتوفر مرة ثانية.

events.detail: The pickup desk refused the oversized carton.
The carrier sorted the carton onto its return route.
The carrier counted the carton into its returns cage. The retailer has not signed for it.

customer_message: The shelves made it back to you. I can confirm a different delivery address if there's another set. If there isn't, please put the money back on my card.

events.detail: Access to the listed receiving point was unavailable.
The parcel was transferred to the retailer's returns route.
Warehouse intake accepted the shelf set and matched it to the prepaid order.
